note: Script: docs/video/haea-howto-script.md. Footage: simulator, demo data only.

scenes.narration: haea reads Apple Health and gives you a daily readiness briefing, all analyzed on your iPhone.
One score, one suggestion for the day, and a warning only when something stands out.
Log strength workouts, and see weekly volume, personal records and a deload check.
Plan a running route on the map, then follow it on your run.
Insights shows which habits move your sleep, pace, weight or mood.
No account, no cloud sync, no ads. General wellness, not medical advice.
haea, free on iPhone. The full tour is on our channel.
